part.content: {"reply":{"text":"Thank you for letting us know. We apologise for the dented box and for the flickering and heating you have experienced. Please cut the power to the strip and check the controller plug. If the flicker continues, the controller will be replaced under warranty. If the controller feels hot, unplug the strip immediately and do not turn it on until it has been inspected. We have issued a €15 store credit to your account.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]} }
